provenance.source_title: The Economics of Owning a Gym

examples.psychological_goal: 用第二人称邀约锁定有开店幻想的观众
examples.expression_mechanism: 资产邀约（So you want to own X）
examples.example_text: Okay, so you want to own a gym.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你想拥有X'直接开场，X选观众自以为看懂的日常生意
examples.negative_instruction: X必须是观众有画面感的生意，不要用陌生标的

examples.psychological_goal: 把观众看到爆满场景时的内心独白原样演出
examples.expression_mechanism: 场景+内心戏重演（you think, printing money）
examples.example_text: You watch that scene and you think, This place must be printing money.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先给场景再替观众说出结论，让拆穿像自我发现
examples.negative_instruction: 内心戏必须是观众真实的想法，不可替观众立稻草人

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话把观众的亲眼所见变成骗局现场
examples.expression_mechanism: 取样偏差点破（the hour it lies to you the most）
examples.example_text: You are looking at the 1 hour of the day it lies to you the most.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'你看到的恰是偏差最大的切片'推翻观众的直接经验
examples.negative_instruction: 点破后必须解释为什么这一小时失真（高峰≠全天）

examples.psychological_goal: 用主语重定义给全片定调
examples.expression_mechanism: 行业重命名（a Y business that happens to have X）
examples.example_text: It is a subscription business that happens to have dumbbells in it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'它是碰巧有X的Y生意'句式完成本质重定义
examples.negative_instruction: 重定义必须在后文用机制（ inactive 会员/统计赌注）兑现

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句比喻让五种业态的分类框架可记忆
examples.expression_mechanism: 同衣不同身比喻（different business wearing the same tracksuit）
examples.example_text: each one is really a different business wearing the same tracksuit.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在罗列分类前先用一个行业相关比喻点破'同名不同命'
examples.negative_instruction: 比喻要贴合行业（运动服之于健身房），不可生硬嫁接

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个单字答案制造'这也要钱？'的意外
examples.expression_mechanism: 悬念+单字落点（the part nobody budgets for: air）
examples.example_text: And then there's the part almost nobody budgets for correctly, air.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先铺'几乎没人算对'的悬念，再给一个极简答案
examples.negative_instruction: 答案必须真的出乎意料且有后文数据（新风公式）支撑

examples.psychological_goal: 用法规公式把'空气要钱'变成可复算的事实
examples.expression_mechanism: 法规公式引用（codes require X per person）
examples.example_text: Building codes require roughly 20 cubic feet of fresh air per minute for every person exercising
examples.usage_instruction: 学习引用具体规范数字，把隐性成本从'听说'变成'写着'
examples.negative_instruction: 法规数字必须真实可查，注明适用范围

examples.psychological_goal: 用白描式冷幽默刻画'沉睡会员'的画像
examples.expression_mechanism: 行为白描冷幽默（twice in January... still paying）
examples.example_text: they show up twice in January, feel good about themselves, and then never come back, while still paying every month.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用平实的行为罗列制造'扎心又好笑'的人物速写
examples.negative_instruction: 幽默对象是行为模式而非具体个人，不落嘲讽

examples.psychological_goal: 揭晓'哪种会员更值钱'的反直觉答案
examples.expression_mechanism: 设问后的反转宣判（costs almost nothing）
examples.example_text: The person who signed up in January and never came back costs the gym almost nothing.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先用两Future对比设问，再用一句宣判给答案
examples.negative_instruction: 宣判后必须立刻给成本对照（热水/毛巾/磨损）

examples.psychological_goal: 用比例数字坐实'沉睡会员'的行业普遍性
examples.expression_mechanism: 行业比例锚（two out of every three）
examples.example_text: around two out of every three gym members rarely or never use the gym they're paying for.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'每三个里有两个'的口语化比例替代百分数
examples.negative_instruction: 比例必须来自行业数据；后文要有机制解释为什么成立

examples.psychological_goal: 把会员制重新定义为统计赌注
examples.expression_mechanism: 产品重定义（selling a statistical bet）
examples.example_text: It's selling a statistical bet that most of the people who buy a membership will not use it at the same time
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'它卖的不是X，是Y'把商业模式翻译成风险语言
examples.negative_instruction: 重定义需有物理证明（消防上限）兜底

examples.psychological_goal: 把'被遗忘的会员'加冕为最赚钱客户
examples.expression_mechanism: 悖论加冕（forgotten = most profitable）
examples.example_text: The forgotten membership, the one sitting unused in someone's bank statement, is quietly one of the most profitable customers a gym can have.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习给悖论对象一个具体意象（躺在银行账单里）再加冕
examples.negative_instruction: 加冕词（quietly）要克制，不可堆砌最高级

examples.psychological_goal: 用留存数据量化'来得快去得也快'
examples.expression_mechanism: 半数千掉率（half stop within 6 months）
examples.example_text: Around half of new members stop attending within 6 months of signing up
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在季节性高峰叙述后立刻给留存数据，防止观众误读为纯利好
examples.negative_instruction: 留存数据需与引流数据同源同口径

examples.psychological_goal: 用承诺机制解释'为什么不用还续费'
examples.expression_mechanism: 心理机制命名（commitment device 的通俗版）
examples.example_text: Paying for the gym is meant to be the thing that forces you to go.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习给观众的自我欺骗行为一个经济学名字
examples.negative_instruction: 机制解释要带着理解而非嘲讽的语气

examples.psychological_goal: 用反证法从退订摩擦推出真实收入结构
examples.expression_mechanism: 反证推断（if X, it wouldn't need to Y）
examples.example_text: If a gym's survival depended on happy, engaged, frequently attending members, it wouldn't need to make canceling this hard.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'如果它靠A活，就不需要B'的反证句式从现象推本质
examples.negative_instruction: 反证的现象（退订摩擦）必须先完整陈列

examples.psychological_goal: 把音乐许可个案升级为全生意的成本观
examples.expression_mechanism: 个案→通则升格（real costs are not in the catalog）
examples.example_text: Almost none of the real costs are the ones printed on the equipment catalog.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'真正的成本不在目录上'把一个小案例升格为大教训
examples.negative_instruction: 升格后必须指出成本真正埋在哪（许可/租约/维护合同）

examples.psychological_goal: 拆穿'爆满=健康'的表象等式
examples.expression_mechanism: 表象拆穿（full parking lots, one bad debt structure away）
examples.example_text: A gym with thousands of members and full parking lots can still be one bad debt structure away from insolvency.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'满眼繁荣+只差一步深渊'的张力句总结案例
examples.negative_instruction: 深渊变量（债务结构）必须与前文案例严格对应

examples.psychological_goal: 用双否定短句拆穿'补流失=增长'的错觉
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定+重命名（not growth, running in place）
examples.example_text: That's not growth. That's running in place.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用两个短句把'维持现状'与'增长'切开
examples.negative_instruction: 必须先给数字（年签300人只为持平），短句才有力量

examples.psychological_goal: 用客户价值换算展示第二收入流的分量
examples.expression_mechanism: 客户价值换算（one X worth dozens of Y）
examples.example_text: One dedicated personal training client can be worth dozens of members who barely use their card.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用'一个A客户抵几十个B客户'的换算排列收入优先级
examples.negative_instruction: 换算需与分成/定价数字一致

examples.psychological_goal: 用'依靠缺席者生存'的悖论金句收束全片
examples.expression_mechanism: 悖论式收束（survive on the people who stop showing up）
examples.example_text: It's about how well you can survive on the people who stop showing up.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把全片机制压缩成一句带悖论的最终建议
examples.negative_instruction: 金句必须是核心机制的直接推论，不可拔高成鸡汤
